# TopologyFitnessLandscape

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mapping of circuit performance metrics across the space of possible interconnect topologies, used to guide evolutionary search. Provides a theoretical framework for understanding why certain topologies are preferred, aiding in the design of TCC-specific search heuristics.
